decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates build directly on Plan Optik's core expertise in structured glass and wafer processing, and glass packaging substrates are a fast-growing semiconductor topic, so the firm can interpret early feedback and refine the product rather than abandon it.

VLIS laser-based through-glass via structuring was just launched with a dedicated page and extends the firm's existing glass microstructuring know-how, and it complements Product A in advanced packaging, giving strong absorptive capacity and reason to keep developing it.
